content: pkgdown extra.css/extra.scss theming: place pkgdown/extra.css for additional CSS (copied and linked after defaults). Place pkgdown/extra.scss for SCSS (compiled into main CSS, preferred — can reference bslib Sass variables like , -bg etc.). template.bslib accepts all bs_theme() args: bg, fg, primary, secondary, success, info, warning, danger, base_font, heading_font, code_font. template.bootswatch: picks a Bootswatch theme. navbar.bg/navbar.type for navbar color class. light-switch: true adds dark/light toggle. _brand.yml via template.bslib.brand for unified cross-tool brand identity. pkgdown/extra.css does NOT need to be in .Rbuildignore if pkgdown/ already is. Two-step: (1) Bootswatch or bslib vars set macro styling; (2) extra.scss/css for fine-grained overrides.
